page.overview:
Who is Senmenjo-ni?

Senmenjo-ni is a non-canon character that made his only appearance in Mortal Kombat novel. He is one of the Black Dragon thugs that travels with Kano in the Mortal Kombat novel.

Nicknamed "Senny" by his peers, he was a former banker/desk-jockey who got burned by insider trading during the gold rush of the 1980's. He was able to stay out of jail by agreeing to become an accountant for the Black Dragon.

Though lacking any physical skills, Kano allows him to accompany him on his missions because of his sharp eyesight and multilingualism.
